scripts.predev: node ./bin/with-deps.cjs tsx scripts/cleanup-processes.ts && node ./bin/with-deps.cjs tsx scripts/start-docker.ts
scripts.prestart: node ./bin/with-deps.cjs tsx scripts/ensure-build.ts && node ./bin/with-deps.cjs tsx scripts/cleanup-processes.ts && node ./bin/with-deps.cjs tsx scripts/start-docker.ts
scripts.rebuild-worker: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml build lynxgeo-worker && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml up -d lynxgeo-worker
scripts.rebuild-worker:dev: docker compose --env-file ../../.env -f docker/services/docker-compose.yml build lynxgeo-worker && docker compose --env-file ../../.env -f docker/services/docker-compose.yml up -d --no-deps --remove-orphans lynxgeo-worker
scripts.test: node ./bin/with-deps.cjs tsx --test tests/score.test.ts tests/check-refs.test.ts tests/snapshot.test.ts tests/series.test.ts tests/analyze.test.ts tests/probes.test.ts tests/origin-scope.test.ts tests/progress.test.ts tests/frontier.test.ts tests/auth-redirect.test.ts
